item.text: {"issues":[{"description":"Reviews report repeated login failures, incorrect connection or number errors, and accounts being logged out unexpectedly.","issue_id":"I_ACCESS","issue_name":"Login and account access problems"},{"description":"Reviews describe dissatisfaction with premium pricing and ads, or difficulty subscribing and accessing paid features after payment.","issue_id":"I_BILLING","issue_name":"Premium pricing and subscription access"},{"description":"Reviews mention missing songs or lyrics, repetitive recommendations, and unavailable podcasts.","issue_id":"I_CATALOG","issue_name":"Missing content and recommendation quality"},{"description":"Reviews report downloads getting stuck, disappearing, or failing to play offline, including after storage changes.","issue_id":"I_DOWNLOADS","issue_name":"Downloads and offline listening failures"},{"description":"Reviews express general dissatisfaction or describe the app as empty or recent updates as poor, without identifying a more specific issue.","issue_id":"I_OTHER","issue_name":"General app dissatisfaction"},{"description":"Reviews report playback stopping, failing to start, showing a black screen, or playing a different song than the one selected.","issue_id":"I_PLAYBACK","issue_name":"Playback interruptions and wrong tracks"},{"description":"Reviews describe confusing navigation and removed or restricted controls, including difficulty finding content and managing playback.","issue_id":"I_USABILITY","issue_name":"Navigation and playback controls"}]}
